scope: Read-only existing checkpoint, source, logs and own usage-spool metadata; no model or accounting mutation

output.semanticAcceptanceSource: Root relayed independent semantic review; original output ends mid-sentence and cannot be imported as complete

observedBudgetEvidence.processLaunchSource: Environment-owner attestation of actual 93b Python launch and offline serialized SDK payload; not per-request finish status

metadataLimits.missingReason: _focused_call joins text only and discards chunk response_metadata and usage; UsageParser persists token totals, not finish_reason

applicationClippingReview.focusedCall: tools.py:_focused_call appends every nonempty stream text chunk and joins them, with no length cap
applicationClippingReview.callSkill: Only whitespace .strip() before nonempty feedback success artifact
applicationClippingReview.feedbackTurn: Returns complete hash-paired ToolMessage text without rewriting it

conclusion: Focused completion reached the configured 2048 budget and no application text clipping was found: strongly supports an output-budget cutoff. Provider finish_reason=length was not retained and is not established. Hash equality proves faithful delivery of incomplete output, not semantic completeness.
nextStepBoundary: Root will authorize one separate compact-summary attempt within the existing 2048 budget. This worker does not invoke, retry, modify tool/harness behavior, or import the failed semantic output.
futureGap: Preserve focused terminal metadata, including metadata on empty-text terminal chunks.

Represent explicit incomplete results without a success feedback marker, and design a stop path that cannot automatically trigger paid retries. These are follow-up design gaps, not changes applied here.
